summative_task_script.title: Big Party Capstone — Summative Administration Guide
summative_task_script.purpose: Ties Lesson 5 capstone, the 4 stations, and the rubric together.
administration_steps: Before: photocopy templates, print rubric, ready Junior Party Planner certificates.
Stations 1-4 (5 min each): PICK, TOTAL, PAY, CHANGE.
Station 1 PICK: choose 4 items. Evidence F1.1.
Station 2 TOTAL: add 4 prices. Evidence F1.1.
Station 4 CHANGE: calculate change. Evidence F1.1.
summative_task_script.scoring_guidance: Use the Capstone Template as primary evidence. Level 3 = grade-level.
